ai.title: AI OCT Retinal Diagnosis (OCT Classification)
ai.description: Upload an OCT retinal scan image (JPG / PNG / BMP, max 10MB). The AI service will analyse retinal layers across 4 pathology classes: CNV (Choroidal Neovascularization) / DME (Diabetic Macular Edema) / DRUSEN (Drusen deposits) / NORMAL.

ai.progressSubtitle: CNN model is scanning retinal structure
ai.symptomsAppliedPrefix: Symptoms recorded from OCT retinal scan:

title.NORMAL: NORMAL (OCT retinal scan within normal limits)

symptoms.CNV: Metamorphopsia, rapid central vision loss, central scotoma, retinal oedema with subretinal haemorrhage.
symptoms.DME: Progressive blurred vision, decreased contrast sensitivity, central blurring or distortion due to fluid accumulation at the macula.
symptoms.DRUSEN: Mild blurred vision, difficulty reading or seeing in low light, yellow deposits accumulating beneath the retinal pigment epithelium.
symptoms.NORMAL: No abnormal symptoms recorded. Retinal layer structure and central macular foveal contour are continuous and normal.

diagnosisSuggestion.CNV: Neovascular (Wet) Age-related Macular Degeneration - Choroidal Neovascularization (CNV)
diagnosisSuggestion.DRUSEN: Dry Age-related Macular Degeneration - Macular Drusen deposits
diagnosisSuggestion.NORMAL: OCT retinal scan within normal limits

treatmentSuggestion.CNV: Intravitreal Anti-VEGF injection (Ranibizumab/Aflibercept) + periodic fundus lesion monitoring
treatmentSuggestion.DME: Glycaemic control HbA1c < 7%, intravitreal Anti-VEGF or retinal laser photocoagulation
treatmentSuggestion.DRUSEN: AREDS2 supplementation (Lutein, Zeaxanthin, Vitamin C/E, Zinc) + 3-6 months follow-up
